name: Profane Geometry
tagline: Sacred forms. Profane materials. A space to gather.

about.statement: An exploration of geometry, material, and the spaces we create together.
about.bio: Profane Geometry is a proposed participatory art installation for Burning Man 2027. Drawing on geometric forms, natural materials, and the tradition of communal gathering, the project explores the relationship between structure and impermanence, the sacred and the everyday, the individual and the collective.

principles.title: Geometry as a meeting place
principles.description: Geometric structures can do more than occupy space. They can invite us to enter, pause, look closer, and encounter one another.

principles.title: Natural materials, intentional design
principles.description: The project explores the expressive possibilities of guadua bamboo and modular construction, connecting structural logic with organic material.

principles.title: An experience made together
principles.description: The installation is conceived as a space for encounter: a place where people can gather, explore, and bring their own presence to the work.
principles.alt: Concept for a communal art space

principles.title: Temporary by nature
principles.description: Built for a temporary environment, the project invites us to consider impermanence, reuse, and the relationship between what we construct and what we leave behind.

faq.a: Profane Geometry is a proposed participatory art installation for Burning Man 2027, exploring the relationship between geometric form, natural materials, and communal space.

The title invites a reconsideration of the boundary between the sacred and the everyday. Geometry can evoke order, harmony, and transcendence, while the materials and encounters of ordinary life ground those ideas in a shared physical experience.

faq.q: What materials will the project use?
faq.a: The concept explores guadua bamboo and modular construction. Final material choices and structural specifications will depend on the design development, engineering, logistics, and site requirements.
The project is being developed around the idea of shared space and collective experience. Opportunities for collaboration and participation will evolve as the installation is developed.

faq.q: What stage is the project in?
faq.a: Profane Geometry is in the proposal and design-development stage for Burning Man 2027. The team is developing the concept, exploring construction approaches, and identifying the next steps needed to realize the installation.
